in_marathi.name: Nishanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious, Conquering, Overcoming
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nishanth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nishantah', which means 'one who conquers', 'one who overcomes' or 'one who has conquered'. This name is often given to a child born into a warrior or royal family, or to a child who is expected to overcome great challenges in life. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often depicted as Nishantah, conquering all evil and bringing peace and prosperity to the world.
